title: Fix Tree Ctrl+click deselect on drag

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #121568

Currently, when multiple items are selected in a `Tree` (like the Scene dock) and you Ctrl+click an already selected item to start dragging, the item gets deselected immediately on the mouse press event. This causes the drag data to only include N-1 items instead of all of them.

This PR fixes it by deferring the toggle-deselect in `SELECT_MULTI` mode until the mouse button is released. If a drag starts before the release event (`NOTIFICATION_DRAG_BEGIN`), the pending deselect is cancelled, keeping all N items selected so they can be dragged together.

## Additional information

This brings the behavior in line with standard file managers, where Ctrl+clicking to drag a selected item retains its selection. Tested locally with the Scene dock and it now correctly drops all selected nodes into the script editor as `@onready var`s.
